summary: Completed S3 upload integration testing for MicLocker. Backend: 15/15 tests passed (100%). Frontend: S3MediaUploader component renders correctly on CreateListingPage. Fixed 2 bugs during testing.
passed_tests: GET /api/uploads/status returns s3_enabled: true, bucket_name, region
POST /api/uploads/presigned-url generates presigned URL with auth
POST /api/uploads/presigned-url with listing_id uses listings/ folder
POST /api/uploads/presigned-put-url generates PUT URL with signature
POST /api/uploads/direct uploads file to S3 successfully
POST /api/listings accepts media array with S3 URLs
All allowed image types accepted (JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF)
All allowed video types accepted (MP4, MOV, WebM)
Frontend: S3MediaUploader component renders on CreateListingPage
Frontend: Media upload input has data-testid attribute
Frontend: File type helper text displayed correctly
Frontend: EditListingPage imports and uses S3MediaUploader

bugs_fixed_during_testing.issue: S3 bucket does not allow ACLs - upload_file and copy_object methods were using ACL='public-read' which caused AccessControlListNotSupported error
bugs_fixed_during_testing.fix: Removed ACL parameter from put_object and copy_object calls - bucket uses bucket policy for public access instead

bugs_fixed_during_testing.issue: ListingInDB validation error when creating listings - None values for shipping, payment_plan, tags were overriding default factories
bugs_fixed_during_testing.fix: Filter out None values from listing_dict before passing to ListingInDB constructor

critical_code_review_comments: S3Service properly handles presigned URL generation for both POST and PUT methods
Upload routes correctly validate file types and sizes
S3MediaUploader component has proper data-testid for testing
CreateListingPage and EditListingPage both import and use S3MediaUploader
Listing creation properly converts S3MediaItem to ListingMedia format
context_for_next_testing_agent: S3 upload integration fully tested and working. Backend endpoints: GET /api/uploads/status, POST /api/uploads/presigned-url, POST /api/uploads/presigned-put-url, POST /api/uploads/direct all working. S3 bucket 'miclocker-saint-louis-bucket' in us-east-2 is configured with bucket policy for public read access (not ACLs). Frontend S3MediaUploader component renders on CreateListingPage and EditListingPage. Test file at /app/backend/tests/test_s3_uploads.py can be reused for regression testing.
